title: KKM theorems and discrete geometry beyond matroids
summary: We introduce selection structures, a topological framework that extends the role played by color classes and matroids in discrete geometry and KKM theorems. Selection structures allow us to extend classic results to genuinely non-matroidal examples, including chessboard complexes and matching complexes. We show that several matroidal versions of classic results can be generalized to selection structures.
